notes.title: Bots Behavior + Temporary Disabling of Squad Mode
Chrono's Arena official release!
notes.content:
After nearly three years of development, with nearly two in early access, the official version of Chrono's Arena is finally available! We'll keep updating and adding new content, and here's what we've prepared for this release :

Skins
Several skins for all characters, including a legendary one for Cyborg, to fill your wardrobe and your existential void. New skins will be added constantly.

Tutorial
No more fuss! Now we have a tutorial explaining all the commands and operation of the three game modes.

Missions
With daily, weekly and fixed missions, you will never enter the arena without objectives again. The rewards are worth it!

Emotes
Whether to celebrate, show affection or simply provoke your opponent, you can now use different Emotes. Use without moderation.

Cross-play
Want to defeat opponents playing on your smartphones? Now you can! (There is no provision for unifying accounts from different devices, although it is in our planning).

New frames, avatars, titles and more!

Our big team is made up of 2 guys who have to rotate between the roles of developers and testers. So if you find an error or bug, don't think twice before letting us know! We are working to better address them. You can contact us on our Discord server or by email: support@bullseyegamestudio.com

We wish you all a great gameplay and see you in the next update!

notes.title: Hotkeys personalization + UI improvements
Party System Update
Game Modes Update + AI
notes.content:
Hello Champions!

Following our goal to minimize the effects of a growing playerbase and giving you an experience closer from the original game, we've added the following features:

 - AI
You'll now encounter Bots in the match. They will be present in one of the new game modes and also in Normal games (more details under the Matchmaking Changes section).

 - New Game Modes
Thanks to the participation of the community, two new game modes were added:

 Solo vs AI - On this mode, you can play alone against AI on the solo mode. We will add duo and squads on future updates.

 1 vs 1 - Two players will be matched to play against each other on a best of five. The gameplay will be similar to the last round of the solo mode.

The three base game modes are now called Normal game. The type of Normal game is still ramdomly selected.

 - Matchmaking Changes
With the addition to the AI, we've made some updates on Normal game matchmaking.

 The max number of players in normal games are 12.
 After 2 minutes elapsed of the creation of the room, the remainig seats will be filled with Bots. We look forward to your feedback, since we can easily increase the queue duration.

 - New UI features
Small updates on the UI were made to improve your experience:

 Added a player online counter on the lobby screen;
 Added a little description above each card of the game mode selection;
 Added a description of wich game mode you are entering when playing Normal game;
 The skills now show its designated hotkey on the ingame UI.


With all those updates we aim to improve your experience playing the game. We will keep working on the bots AI and also on new features. Keep tuned to the next updates!

Enter our Discord Server to meet other players and have direct access to Developers.

notes.title: Matchmaking update
notes.content:
Hello Champions!

In order to minimize the effects of the small playerbase, we've made some changes on the game that differ from the original description:

 The number of players needed to start a match was decreased to 6 (instead of 12);
 Squad mode now have only 2 teams;
 Game modes will be randomly selected.

As soon as we have enough players these changes will be reversed.

We are working on bots AI, and will include the option to play against them as soon as possible. Furthermore, we are working on new features too.

Remember, you can meet us on the community forums anytime.

Thank you for your patience! 
Bullseye Team.
